purpose: Track Russian state-linked bot farms, coordinated inauthentic behavior and platform-distribution exploitation as a distinct influence lane from TSPU/network control. Preserve the user's observed Instagram/Threads patterns as an unattributed lead until independently linked to known Russian infrastructure or behavior.
epistemic_firewall: TSPU/network control and social-platform influence are distinct mechanisms that may reinforce each other but must not be conflated.
High engagement, repeated narratives or suspicious account behavior do not by themselves establish Russian attribution.
Platform recommendation/ranking systems can distribute engaging content without the platform intentionally supporting the campaign.
Instagram has documented Russian coordinated inauthentic behavior precedents. This pass did not independently confirm that the user's observed Threads accounts belong to a Russian operation.
Individual users should not be politically profiled; analysis should stay at aggregate network/behavior/infrastructure level.

user_observation.claim: The user reports seeing signs of coordinated bot activity and pro-Russian propaganda propagation through Instagram and Threads recommendation/engagement dynamics.
user_observation.use: Seed a falsifiable collection lane, not a factual attribution statement.

confirmed_external_precedents.finding: Meta removed coordinated inauthentic networks on Facebook and Instagram that originated in Russia; one operation targeted Ukraine and another multiple countries.
Meta disrupted a Russia/Ukraine-operated network of fake accounts, Pages and Groups targeting people in Ukraine across Facebook, Instagram and other platforms/websites.
DOJ/FBI disrupted a Russian government-backed AI-enhanced bot farm using 968 social-media accounts and fictitious personas to spread Russian-government narratives in the United States and abroad.

DOJ attributed the Doppelganger campaign to Russian government-directed entities using fake profiles, influencers, paid social-media advertising, AI-generated content and impersonated media domains to shape U.S. and foreign audiences.

mechanism_model.lane_A_network_control: TSPU/DPI/routing/allowlist can reduce which external sources or communications remain reachable.
mechanism_model.lane_B_platform_manipulation: Coordinated fake personas, bots, influencers, ads and cross-platform content can manufacture apparent engagement, repetition and social proof inside reachable platforms.
mechanism_model.combined_candidate_effect: If external information access is constrained while coordinated platform influence remains reachable, the relative share and apparent popularity of aligned narratives can increase.
mechanism_model.critical_limit: No evidence currently establishes that TSPU restrictions and the user's observed Instagram/Threads activity are part of one coordinated operation.

algorithmic_amplification_hypothesis.safe_form: Coordinated bot or fake-persona activity may exploit engagement/recommendation systems by generating interactions, repetition and apparent popularity, thereby increasing distribution probability without needing direct control of the platform algorithm.
not_claimed: The recommendation algorithm is controlled by Russia.
Every account repeating a narrative is automated or coordinated.
Threads currently hosts a confirmed Russian botnet matching the user's observations.

collection_plan: Freeze public post/account URLs, timestamps and screenshots before interpretation where lawful and non-sensitive.
Cluster by repeated text, URLs, media hashes, posting-time synchronization and shared external domains.
Separate obvious organic users from accounts showing coordinated inauthentic behavior indicators.
Track whether the same narrative appears first on known Russian/state-linked domains or previously attributed campaign infrastructure.
Compare engagement bursts against matched non-political control posts to avoid mistaking normal recommendation dynamics for manipulation.
Preserve language/region/time-zone/network clues only as weak signals unless independently corroborated.
Escalate attribution only with infrastructure, platform enforcement, government attribution, or strong cross-platform campaign linkage.

agency_relevance.FBI: HIGH — directly relevant to foreign malign influence, covert bot farms, fake personas, U.S. audience targeting and infrastructure attribution.
agency_relevance.ODNI_FMIC: HIGH — useful as a separate influence-distribution lane that could be coupled with network isolation in a strategic scenario.
agency_relevance.STATE_CFIMI: HIGH — relevant to foreign information manipulation, partner awareness and resilient information ecosystems.
agency_relevance.CISA: LOW_TO_MEDIUM — relevant only where bot/influence infrastructure overlaps with cyber/network infrastructure; not a primary propaganda-analysis lane.
